items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did Robichaux's band and Huron's band have a hot tone? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I'd say they played the same, I think they recorded I have never heard their records but for enough people I've heard they didn't have jazz.

ctx.x: Raiding, there were no raiding. Absolutely no greeners. Were they fake at all? I don't know. I wasn't allowed in the place. Oh, I see. The how come, I used to be an electrician in my early days. And many times I was sent to DeSoto Hotel to do work over underneath there. You know, they were on electrical equipment. Or some line would go out and I'd have to pull new wires through it. I worked for Mark's construction company at that time. That was down in 531 Island Institute. That was the biggest, largest…
Did Robichaux's band and Huron's band have a hot tone? Would you say they had a jazz tone or a legitimate tone or what?

Well, I'd say they played the same, I think they recorded I have never heard their records but for enough people I've heard they didn't have jazz. Now I'm not quoting myself because what I heard, I heard the same music in white bands. They mention many bands but they don't mention Bowers, the Christians, the Detroit's band and the Cordy's band. They don't mention none of the white bands, all the Negroes as a culture Louisiana music. That's not right. Because the culture of Louisiana music, it was because of so…
